scope: October 17-23 UTC; exact-title arrivals October 18-24, October 24 partial before evening publication; flatrate/free/ads only

flapping.limitations: History-only returns do not prove physical deletion. Backup proves a prior physical incarnation; current created_at proves a later incarnation. Surviving rows only, baseline-backed keys only, eligible offer types only. No per-publication snapshots or producer IDs; exact all-key week total and recheck-caused removal count are not reconstructible.

cancelled_preview: 01a16ef4-b35d-ac31-ec1f-f315273ccdd3 (broad SELECT join stopped; replaced by bounded SELECTs and in-memory joins)

method.run_requests: One GET per logged next entry. Sum of leaf batch IDs and next-entry log lines agree; no retry flags or failed iterations.
method.recheck_attribution: Match title identity and history.observed_at to the successful recheck leaf batch interval. No durable producer ID; evidence-based attribution, not a counterfactual incremental count. Histories survive later deletions.
method.new_us_retained: Intersect attributed history keys with current US rows created on the corresponding UTC day; current rows omit later deletions.
method.exact_arrivals: availability_history appeared_source='title' AND appeared_precision='exact', grouped by appeared_on; both title fetches and daily lists contribute.
method.list_overlap: Match country/media/service against completed list scopes for the same day; this measures overlapping coverage, not duplicate HTTP fetches or duplicate stored stays.

counts.current_us_by_day: SELECT date_trunc('day',created_at) AS day, count(*) AS offers, count(DISTINCT media_type || ':' || cast(media_tmdb_id AS TEXT)) AS titles FROM streaming_availability WHERE country_code='US' AND streaming_type IN ('flatrate','free','ads') AND created_at >= '2026-10-17T00:00:00Z' AND created_at < '2026-10-24T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 100
counts.exact_title_daily: SELECT appeared_on AS day, country_code, count(*) AS offers, count(DISTINCT media_type || ':' || cast(media_tmdb_id AS TEXT)) AS titles FROM availability_history WHERE appeared_source='title' AND appeared_precision='exact' AND appeared_on >= '2026-10-18T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 10000
counts.changed_history: SELECT count(*) AS rows FROM availability_history WHERE observed_at >= '2026-10-17T00:00:00Z'
counts.closed_history: SELECT count(*) AS rows FROM availability_history WHERE dropped_on >= '2026-10-17T00:00:00Z' AND dropped_on < '2026-10-24T00:00:00Z'
counts.backup_summary: SELECT count(*) AS rows, min(created_at) AS min_created, max(created_at) AS max_created, min(observed_at) AS min_observed, max(observed_at) AS max_observed, count(dropped_on) AS dropped FROM availability_history_before_682
counts.schema: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='doc' AND table_name IN ('streaming_availability','streaming_evidence','availability_history','streaming_service') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position LIMIT 300

core.us_new_rows: SELECT * FROM streaming_availability WHERE country_code='US' AND streaming_type IN ('flatrate','free','ads') AND created_at >= '2026-10-17T00:00:00Z' AND created_at < '2026-10-24T00:00:00Z' LIMIT 100001
core.exact_title_rows: SELECT * FROM availability_history WHERE appeared_source='title' AND appeared_precision='exact' AND appeared_on >= '2026-10-18T00:00:00Z' LIMIT 100001
core.recheck_time_history: SELECT * FROM availability_history WHERE (observed_at >= 1792760400021 AND observed_at <= 1792761865191) OR (observed_at >= 1792674000004 AND observed_at <= 1792675486688) OR (observed_at >= 1792587600017 AND observed_at <= 1792589043090) OR (observed_at >= 1792501200012 AND observed_at <= 1792502607522) OR (observed_at >= 1792414800011 AND observed_at <= 1792416220295) OR (observed_at >= 1792328400004 AND observed_at <= 1792329796291) OR (observed_at >= 1792242000010 AND observed_at <= 1792243449897) LIMIT 100001
